diagnosis.overview: The worker fails to systematically deconstruct multi-part task instructions into a verifiable checklist of required deliverables and source data, resulting in repeated omission of tabs/summaries/flags and reliance on hallucinated generic numbers instead of extracting precise values.
diagnosis.root_cause: The worker fails to systematically deconstruct multi-part task instructions into a verifiable checklist of required deliverables and source data, resulting in repeated omission of tabs/summaries/flags and reliance on hallucinated generic numbers instead of extracting precise values.
diagnosis.general_mechanism: 1. PROMPT RULE: Enforce a mandatory planning phase where the agent first parses the task prompt, explicitly lists all required outputs (sheets, columns, summary cells, formatting rules, threshold flags), then performs a final verification pass against that checklist before delivering the workbook. 2. TOOL BINDING: Wire a structured PDF/table-extraction utility to precisely pull invoice details, financial schedules, and numeric criteria from source documents, eliminating guesswork and blanket assumptions.
